narration: This picture begins with rotating circles. Each circle supplies a vector with a measured radius, a rotation frequency, and a starting phase. Add those vectors, and the final tip becomes the drawing pen.

title: Every small circle matters
narration: Here is one smaller contour, enlarged. Its sixty four terms include one fixed offset and sixty three rotating circles. Large circles establish the shape. Small circles refine the detail. Negative frequencies rotate in the opposite direction.

title: All 651 chains at work
body: Every tip traces one closed outline.
narration: Now all six hundred fifty one chains run together. You are seeing all forty one thousand thirteen rotating circles. Their tips trace the stored contours at two thousand forty eight samples per orbit. These outlines will define the portrait.

title: A contour becomes a region
body: Test whether each pixel lies inside.
The stored sign adds or subtracts tone.
narration: A closed outline tells us which pixels lie inside it. The nonzero winding test creates that region. Each stored sign then adds or subtracts its tone increment. Subtracting regions preserves holes and interior details.

title: Lightning is another field
body: 15 paths from the supplied bolt data.
Distance and envelope control the glow.
narration: The lightning is calculated separately. Fifteen paths use oscillating offsets to form the branches. Distance from each sampled path sets the glow, and the fracture envelope controls its strength. That light field is added to the portrait tone.

title: Grain from 29 cosine waves
body: Clamp the result between zero and one.
narration: The tone passes through a sigmoid. Twenty nine cosine waves then add the specified grain. This texture is deterministic too. The same equations produce the same pattern every time.

title: One field becomes three colours
body: Blend linear and cubic shade per channel.
Quantize each RGB value to an integer.
narration: Finally, the supplied Perron vector controls the red, green, and blue channels. Each channel blends the shade with its cube. That turns the single brightness field into this warm gold palette.
